description: Controlled repeat of the g0 calibration pair after the anomalous k=2 first-campaign result.
rationale: The local-only diagnostic showed that both the logical g0 k=2 circuit and the saved transpiled QASM predict p=0.25 exactly.
The backend-aware diagnostic predicted p=0.284180 for the original saved QASM but the hardware result was p_hat=0.597656.
Optimization level 2 reduced g0 k=2 from depth 180 and 24 two-qubit gates to depth 71 and 19 two-qubit gates, with the best noisy prediction among tested backend-aware variants.
A repeat should isolate the g0 calibration pair before spending credits on deeper g1/g2 schedules.

selected_jobs.purpose: Repeat the amplitude calibration pair with optimization_level=2.

deferred_jobs.reason: Do not submit until the g0 k=2 anomaly is resolved.

stopping_rules: Prepare this campaign first without --submit and inspect the resulting transpiled depths.
Submit only the two g0 circuits; do not combine this repeat with g1/g2 deferred jobs.
If the repeat g0 k=2 remains far from p=0.25, move to layout selection or error mitigation rather than increasing k or depth.
